data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for integrating Google Maps in Android, iOS, and web applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GoogleMap widget that embeds Google Maps natively into your Flutter app. Allows control over camera position, markers, ground overlays, heatmaps, and map types using a GoogleMapController.
use_when: You need official Google Maps integration in your app across Android, iOS, and Web
You require advanced markers, custom map styling, or clustering support
avoid_when: You want a map solution that doesn't require setting up a Google Cloud API key and billing
You prefer an open-source map provider that does not rely on Google's proprietary services
strengths: Official Google Maps support with regular feature updates
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, and Web
Extensive feature set including clustering, heatmaps, and advanced markers
weaknesses: Requires a Google Cloud project, API key, and billing setup
Certain platform implementations or legacy SDK versions require specific manual setup
data.setup_notes: Requires getting a Google Maps API key from the Google Cloud Console and enabling the Maps SDK for Android, iOS, and Web, plus platform-specific setup as detailed in the endorsed platform packages.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: A customizable open-source map widget that doesn't require a Google Maps API key or billing.

alternatives.name: mapbox_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want to use Mapbox vector maps instead of Google Maps.

data.minimal_example:
GoogleMap(
  mapType: MapType.hybrid,
  initialCameraPosition: CameraPosition(
    target: LatLng(37.42796133580664, -122.085749655962),
    zoom: 14.4746,
  ),
)
